# https://ckmah.github.io/milume/docs/reference/ui/landmarks.md

# Landmarks

<figure class="ml-hero" markdown="0">
<video class="ml-loop" autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="../../assets/tools/landmarks/hero" data-theme="dark" poster="../../../assets/tools/landmarks/hero.dark.poster.webp" aria-label="A spline landmark is drawn point by point, a buffer is widened around it, then the landmark is deleted." width="960" height="600"><source src="../../assets/tools/landmarks/hero.dark.webm" type="video/webm"><source src="../../assets/tools/landmarks/hero.dark.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>
<img class="ml-loop-poster" src="../../assets/tools/landmarks/hero.dark.poster.webp" alt="A spline landmark is drawn point by point, a buffer is widened around it, then the landmark is deleted." width="960" height="600" loading="lazy">
</figure>

Click to place landmark vertices, press Enter to finish, then widen a buffer around the line.
{: .ml-caption }

```python
import milume
w = milume.peek(adata)  # press 3, click points, Enter
w.landmarks             # list of landmark dicts
```

Landmarks are durable geometric annotations (points, lines, splines, shapes). Selections are analysis regions; see [Select regions](select-regions.md).

## Draw tools

The four landmark tools share one toolbar button. Click it to arm the last-used tool, or right-click it to pick another.

<div class="ml-controls" markdown>

| | Control | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle></svg> | Point (1) | Click once to place a point. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 5H19V11"></path><path d="M19 5L5 19"></path></svg> | Line (2) | Click vertices of a polyline; press Enter to finish. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="19" cy="5" r="2"></circle><circle cx="5" cy="19" r="2"></circle><path d="M5 17A12 12 0 0 1 17 5"></path></svg> | Spline (3) | Click control points of a smooth curve; press Enter to finish. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.83 2.38a2 2 0 0 1 2.34 0l8 5.74a2 2 0 0 1 .73 2.25l-3.04 9.26a2 2 0 0 1-1.9 1.37H7.04a2 2 0 0 1-1.9-1.37L2.1 10.37a2 2 0 0 1 .73-2.25z"></path></svg> | Shape (4) | Click vertices of a closed shape; press Enter to finish. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12.034 12.681a.498.498 0 0 1 .647-.647l9 3.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.033.943l-3.444 1.068a1 1 0 0 0-.66.66l-1.067 3.443a.5.5 0 0 1-.943.033z"></path><path d="M5 17A12 12 0 0 1 17 5"></path><circle cx="19" cy="5" r="2"></circle><circle cx="5" cy="19" r="2"></circle></svg> | Node (N) | Drag, insert or delete vertices of the selected landmark. |

</div>

## Context toolbar

Click a landmark with Select (V) to open its toolbar at the bottom of the map.

<figure class="ml-hero ml-hero--still" markdown="0">
<img class="ml-only-dark" src="../../assets/tools/landmarks/still-toolbar.dark.png" alt="A spline landmark with a wide buffer and its context toolbar. Amber callouts: 1 Color, 2 Tension, 3 the Buffer width slider, 4 Make selection from buffer, 5 Convert type." loading="lazy">
<img class="ml-only-light" src="../../assets/tools/landmarks/still-toolbar.light.png" alt="A spline landmark with a wide buffer and its context toolbar. Amber callouts: 1 Color, 2 Tension, 3 the Buffer width slider, 4 Make selection from buffer, 5 Convert type." loading="lazy">
</figure>

<div class="ml-controls" markdown>

| | Control | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| | Line style | Toggle solid or dashed. |
| <span class="ml-badge">1</span> | Color | Six swatches plus a custom color. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle><line x1="3" x2="9" y1="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="15" x2="21" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg> <span class="ml-badge">2</span> | Tension | How tightly a spline follows its control points. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.1 2.18a9.93 9.93 0 0 1 3.8 0"></path><path d="M17.6 3.71a9.95 9.95 0 0 1 2.69 2.7"></path><path d="M21.82 10.1a9.93 9.93 0 0 1 0 3.8"></path><path d="M20.29 17.6a9.95 9.95 0 0 1-2.7 2.69"></path><path d="M13.9 21.82a9.94 9.94 0 0 1-3.8 0"></path><path d="M6.4 20.29a9.95 9.95 0 0 1-2.69-2.7"></path><path d="M2.18 13.9a9.93 9.93 0 0 1 0-3.8"></path><path d="M3.71 6.4a9.95 9.95 0 0 1 2.7-2.69"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1"></circle></svg> <span class="ml-badge">3</span> | Buffer | Signed buffer width: negative is left or in, positive is right or out. <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 7-5 5 5 5"></path><path d="m15 7 5 5-5 5"></path></svg> Both sides makes it symmetric; Reset buffer sets it to 0. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M8 12h8"></path><path d="M12 8v8"></path></svg> <span class="ml-badge">4</span> | Make selection from buffer | Turn the cells inside the buffer into a selection. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3 4 7l4 4"></path><path d="M4 7h16"></path><path d="m16 21 4-4-4-4"></path><path d="M20 17H4"></path></svg> | Reverse | Flip the direction of a line or spline. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.83 2.38a2 2 0 0 1 2.34 0l8 5.74a2 2 0 0 1 .73 2.25l-3.04 9.26a2 2 0 0 1-1.9 1.37H7.04a2 2 0 0 1-1.9-1.37L2.1 10.37a2 2 0 0 1 .73-2.25z"></path></svg> <span class="ml-badge">5</span> | Convert type | Convert between Line, Spline and Shape. |

</div>

# https://ckmah.github.io/milume/docs/reference/ui/navigate.md

# Navigate

<figure class="ml-hero" markdown="0">
<video class="ml-loop" autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="../../assets/tools/navigate/hero" data-theme="dark" poster="../../../assets/tools/navigate/hero.dark.poster.webp" aria-label="The map zooms in on the cells, pans across them, then returns to the full view." width="960" height="600"><source src="../../assets/tools/navigate/hero.dark.webm" type="video/webm"><source src="../../assets/tools/navigate/hero.dark.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>
<img class="ml-loop-poster" src="../../assets/tools/navigate/hero.dark.poster.webp" alt="The map zooms in on the cells, pans across them, then returns to the full view." width="960" height="600" loading="lazy">
</figure>

Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, and press 0 to fit the whole tissue back in view.
{: .ml-caption }

```python
import milume
w = milume.peek(sdata)  # press H to pan, = / - to zoom, 0 to reset
```

# https://ckmah.github.io/milume/docs/reference/ui/probe.md

# Probe

<figure class="ml-hero" markdown="0">
<video class="ml-loop" autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="../../assets/tools/probe/hero" data-theme="dark" poster="../../../assets/tools/probe/hero.dark.poster.webp" aria-label="The probe ring moves in a figure-eight over the raster bins, and the bins recolor by similarity to the bin under the ring." width="960" height="600"><source src="../../assets/tools/probe/hero.dark.webm" type="video/webm"><source src="../../assets/tools/probe/hero.dark.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>
<img class="ml-loop-poster" src="../../assets/tools/probe/hero.dark.poster.webp" alt="The probe ring moves in a figure-eight over the raster bins, and the bins recolor by similarity to the bin under the ring." width="960" height="600" loading="lazy">
</figure>

Hover a bin with Probe on; similar bins light up. Click to pin the query.
{: .ml-caption }

Probe compares raster bins, so switch the map to raster first (<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v18"></path><path d="M3 12h18"></path><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"></rect></svg> points/raster; see [Color & layers](color-layers.md)).

```python
import milume
w = milume.peek(adata, genes=["GeneA", "GeneB", "GeneC"])
w.set_render_mode("raster")  # then press P and hover
```

## Controls

<div class="ml-controls" markdown>

| | Control | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="2" x2="5" y1="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="19" x2="22" y1="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="2" y2="5"></line><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="19" y2="22"></line><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7"></circle></svg> | Probe (P) | Hover a bin to color every bin by its similarity to it; click to pin that bin. |
| | Similarity legend | Color scale from 0 (dissimilar) to 1 (identical), shown in the right panel while Probe is on. |
| | Esc | Clear the probe. |

</div>

With the genes tab active, similarity uses the picked genes; pick at least one gene first, or hovering does nothing.

<img class="ml-only-light" src="../../assets/tools/probe/still-pinned.light.png" alt="A pinned probe ring on the raster, with the Similarity legend from 0 to 1 in the right panel under the gene densities." loading="lazy">
</figure>

See [Synced traitlets](../api/landmarks.md#synced-traitlets) and [Methods](../api/landmarks.md#methods).

# Select regions

<figure class="ml-hero" markdown="0">
<video class="ml-loop" autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/hero" data-theme="dark" poster="../../../assets/tools/select-regions/hero.dark.poster.webp" aria-label="A lasso is drawn around a group of cells; the cells inside stay bright, a selection row appears in the layers list, then the selection is removed." width="960" height="600"><source src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/hero.dark.webm" type="video/webm"><source src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/hero.dark.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>
<img class="ml-loop-poster" src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/hero.dark.poster.webp" alt="A lasso is drawn around a group of cells; the cells inside stay bright, a selection row appears in the layers list, then the selection is removed." width="960" height="600" loading="lazy">
</figure>

Draw a lasso, square, circle or shape around cells, then read the selection back in Python.
{: .ml-caption }

```python
import milume
w = milume.peek(adata)  # press L, then drag around some cells
sel_id = w.selections[-1]["id"]
```

## Controls

The four selection tools share one toolbar button. Click it to arm the last-used tool, or right-click it to pick another.

<div class="ml-controls" markdown>

| | Control | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3.704 14.467a10 8 0 1 1 3.115 2.375"></path><path d="M7 22a5 5 0 0 1-2-3.994"></path><circle cx="5" cy="16" r="2"></circle></svg> | Lasso (L) | Drag a freehand outline. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="3" rx="2"></rect></svg> | Square (R) | Drag a rectangle. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle></svg> | Circle (O) | Drag an ellipse. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.83 2.38a2 2 0 0 1 2.34 0l8 5.74a2 2 0 0 1 .73 2.25l-3.04 9.26a2 2 0 0 1-1.9 1.37H7.04a2 2 0 0 1-1.9-1.37L2.1 10.37a2 2 0 0 1 .73-2.25z"></path></svg> | Shape (G) | Click vertices of a polygon; press Enter to finish. |
| <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg> | Shape menu (right-click) | Choose which of the four tools the button arms. |

</div>

### Square and circle

### While a selection is active

The cells inside stay at full color and the right panel counts only them. A small toolbar at the bottom of the map offers <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.1 2.18a9.93 9.93 0 0 1 3.8 0"></path><path d="M17.6 3.71a9.95 9.95 0 0 1 2.69 2.7"></path><path d="M21.82 10.1a9.93 9.93 0 0 1 0 3.8"></path><path d="M20.29 17.6a9.95 9.95 0 0 1-2.7 2.69"></path><path d="M13.9 21.82a9.94 9.94 0 0 1-3.8 0"></path><path d="M6.4 20.29a9.95 9.95 0 0 1-2.69-2.7"></path><path d="M2.18 13.9a9.93 9.93 0 0 1 0-3.8"></path><path d="M3.71 6.4a9.95 9.95 0 0 1 2.7-2.69"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1"></circle></svg> Radius neighborhood and <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m10.586 5.414-5.172 5.172"></path><path d="m18.586 13.414-5.172 5.172"></path><path d="M6 12h12"></path><circle cx="12" cy="20" r="2"></circle><circle cx="12" cy="4" r="2"></circle><circle cx="20" cy="12" r="2"></circle><circle cx="4" cy="12" r="2"></circle></svg> k-NN neighborhood around the selection, with <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="ml-icon" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M8 12h8"></path><path d="M12 8v8"></path></svg> Make selection to keep that neighborhood as a new selection. Press <kbd>⌫</kbd> or <kbd>Delete</kbd> to remove the active selection.

<figure class="ml-hero" markdown="0">
<video class="ml-loop" autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/loop-knn" data-theme="dark" poster="../../../assets/tools/select-regions/loop-knn.dark.poster.webp" aria-label="A square selection with k-NN neighborhood on; the k slider moves up and back and the ring of neighboring cells grows and shrinks." width="960" height="600"><source src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/loop-knn.dark.webm" type="video/webm"><source src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/loop-knn.dark.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>
<img class="ml-loop-poster" src="../../assets/tools/select-regions/loop-knn.dark.poster.webp" alt="A square selection with k-NN neighborhood on; the k slider moves up and back and the ring of neighboring cells grows and shrinks." width="960" height="600" loading="lazy">
</figure>

Read selections in Python with [Use selections downstream](../../how-to/use-selections-downstream.md). See [Methods](../api/landmarks.md#methods) for the full signatures.
